**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/04/01 (Sat) 18:42
- [FACT] User inquired about the HP 14-bp111tx laptop.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The HP 14-bp111tx laptop comes with a 2.5-inch SATA hard drive.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can replace the 2.5-inch SATA hard drive with a 2.5-inch SATA solid-state drive (SSD) for improved performance and faster boot times.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The laptop does not support M.2 or NVMe SSDs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The HP 14-bp111tx does not have an M.2 slot for these types of drives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the user wants to upgrade the laptop's storage with an SSD, they should look for a 2.5-inch SATA SSD.
